text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 4: At midday in summer 2025/26, power drawn is 1.9 to 3.0 MW lower on clear days than on overcast days'
text.tspan: Figure 4: At midday in summer 2025/26, power drawn is 1.9 to 3.0 MW
lower on clear days than on overcast days

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean power drawn from the electricity network (MW) from 11:00 to 14:00 local time on summer days (April to September), per season-year, at six Primary substations. No weather or statistical model is involved. Dot: mean over days. Vertical line: 95% interval for the mean (t distribution across days, which are treated as independent). Overcast days are few: 4 to 15 per summer. Summer here is September 2025 and April to August 2026 for 2025/26. Overcast days also differ from clear days in temperature and demand, so the gap is more than the solar output alone. Each panel has its own y axis.'
